15.24.030
Liens.
Any lien against property pursuant to Chapter 15.24 shallbe a priority lien, and shall have
priority over all other liens except prior tax or assessment liens.
Section 2. That sections currently existing in Chapter 15.24 not set out within this ordinance
remain unchanged.
Section 3.That this ordinance shall be in full force and effect upon its approval and
publication.
